literal_meaning: কেউ (someone/any) কেউ (someone/any) – referring to unspecified individuals
example_sentences_in_bangla: কেউ কেউ এই পরিবর্তনকে সমর্থন করে।
কেউ কেউ এখানে আসতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: Some people don't want to come here.
note: This phrase is a standard expression in Bengali for referring to an unspecified subset of people, more literal than figurative.
